notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Necrosynthesis attached to Herd Baloth.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Beast token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
